title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
task: Parallel token generation speedup for LLMs via discrete diffusion
key_results: Up to 3× speedup over base AR model; 8B Uno outperforms 26B DiffusionGemma and Mercury 2 on agentic tool use, coding, and long-context reasoning
comments: Cleverly decouples AR and diffusion weights to avoid draft model overhead; lossless acceleration is significant if the claimed speedups hold across diverse workloads.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lightweight diffusion weights can be trained via Distillation Distillation without sacrificing AR model quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves higher throughput than speculative decoding across all batch sizes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uno can be applied to existing open-weight AR LLMs with negligible training overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; released as augmentation method

title: FlowBalance: Verifier-Grounded Self-Improvement from On-Policy Reasoning Experience
task: Verifier-grounded self-improvement from on-policy reasoning experience
key_results: FlowBalance improves average performance over FlowRL on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B; higher correct-strategy diversity on AIME24 diagnostic; avoids response-length collapse
comments: Elegant approach to calibrate self-guidance via trajectory balance and energy reweighting; the within-group contrast preservation guarantee is theoretically grounded.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Outcome-calibrated self-guidance via trajectory balance prevents false-positive guidance on rejected responses
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; establishes exact correction against false-positive self-guidance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-level log-probability gains aggregated to trajectory scores improve stability over dense imitation loss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improves training speed and stability on both model sizes

title: ENEAS: Embedding-guided Neural Ensemble for Adaptive Segmentation
task: Text-promptable instance tracking and semantic discovery in video
key_results: Tracks unique instances precisely and discovers all instances matching text queries; filters out ontological errors (statues/paintings/reflections) via semantic verification layer
comments: Addresses a real pain point in video segmentation (hallucinations, fragmentation, misclassification); hybrid visual-embedding + conditional VLM approach is pragmatic for 3D reconstruction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal memory in SeC architecture prevents target drift on disappearance and fragmentation at extreme close-ups
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tracks held through disappearance and kept whole even when filling entire view

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conditional VLM refinement on high-speed embedding candidates filters ontological errors without high latency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; discriminates true instances from visually similar artifacts

title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
task: Critical review of failure modes in on-policy self-distillation
key_results: Identifies collapse (progressive narrowing of reasoning paths) as dominant failure mode governed by three levers: token weighting, privileged information nature, and teacher dynamics
comments: Provides valuable structural vocabulary and taxonomy rather than novel experiments; helps clarify what is settled versus disputed in OPSD research.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Collapse is governed by (i) token weighting, (ii) privileged information design, and (iii) teacher dynamics
hypotheses.result: Established framework; identifies levers for mitigation across literature

title: EmbodiedSkills: A Unified Framework for Orchestrating, Training, and Deploying VLA Agents
task: Unified framework for orchestrating and deploying vision-language-action robot agents
key_results: 86.20% average success on 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks; 97.40% across four LIBERO suites; 12.5% average success on four memory-dependent RMBench tasks
comments: Clean separation of high-level skill selection from low-level VLA execution via fixed interface enables modularity; structured trajectory recording supports optional online adaptation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fixed executable-skill interface allows VLA policy replacement without changing agent loop
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; framework demonstrated with two different VLA models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured trajectory recording from planning/execution/verification/recovery supports supervision for individual components
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables optional online adaptation with interactive feedback

title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
task: Verifier-based gating for on-policy distillation reliability
key_results: TGOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD across 4B and 35B students on math, code, and instruction following; increases teacher GPU utilization from 9.8% to 78.9%
comments: Simple yet effective idea: verify teacher reliability per prompt before admitting dense supervision, routing to GRPO otherwise; improves compute efficiency.

outputs: dense OPD supervision (if reliable) or GRPO (if unreliable)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Prompt-level reliability estimation via verifier-scored teacher probes prevents confidently wrong teachers from inducing strong misleading updates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms Vanilla OPD across six single-domain and multi-domain settings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Using idle teacher capacity for reliability estimation reduces teacher-side compute waste in asynchronous OPD
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GPU utilization increased from 9.8% to 78.9%

title: Safety for Whom? Boundary-Aware Self-Distillation for Controlled LLM Safety Refusal
task: Boundary-aware safety alignment with domain-specific refusal policies
key_results: Political persuasion refusal improved from 9.47% to 84.75% on Qwen3-8B; mean unsafe-response rate reduced from 26.26% to 0.14% across benchmarks; escalating retries reduced missing refusal traces from 19.88% to 0.20%
comments: Trade-off between target refusal and over-refusal is inherent; boundary-pair data effectively controls safety-usability balance but evaluation on both sides of boundaries is critical.

inputs: safety-aligned prompts with controlled topic generation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Escalating retries improve coverage of refusal traces compared to single-shot generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 0.20% vs 19.88% missing traces

hypotheses.hypothesis: Boundary-pair data reduces over-refusal on comply-side while maintaining harmful-side refusal
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: comply-side over-refusal reduced from 32.94% to 4.16%, but harmful-side refusal only slightly decreased (91.88% to 87.72%)

title: What Else Needs Fixing? Exploring Cost-Effective Test-Time Compute for Revision Propagation in Artifacts Generated Through Conversation
task: Cost-effective test-time compute for revision propagation in conversational artifacts
key_results: Baselines achieve 68.3–93% accuracy; best cost-effective method (parallel sampling with LLM-based or medoid selection) improves accuracy by 2.2–9.7%
comments: Practical benchmark for a neglected problem (local revision requiring dependency tracking); medoid selection is computationally cheaper than LLM-based selection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parallel sampling from LLMs with selection outperforms sequential reflection for revision propagation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; parallel sampling with medoid selection achieves best cost-effectiveness

title: Unifying Conformal Language Tasks with In-Context Ensembles
task: Unified conformal prediction for NLP content retrieval tasks with coverage-conciseness trade-off
key_results: Framework applied successfully to 7 NLP tasks (summarization, QA, etc.); theoretically characterized complementarity conditions for ensemble improvement; maintains coverage guarantees while improving conciseness with minimal manual prompt engineering
comments: In-context learning via example curation elegantly replaces task-specific manual prompts; theoretical saturation bounds on ensemble improvement provide principled guidance for ensemble design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: In-context ensemble scoring maintains coverage while improving conciseness vs. hand-engineered prompts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across 7 tasks with minimal manual input required

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble diversity improves worst-case sentence scores under complementarity conditions
hypotheses.result: Theoretically characterized with saturation bounds on improvement

title: Causal Foundation Models
task: Foundation models for causal inference using in-context learning
key_results: CFMs estimate causal quantities (e.g., average treatment effect) on new datasets without fine-tuning via in-context learning; generalizable across diverse settings and modalities
comments: This appears to be a position/tutorial paper rather than empirical study; significant practical questions about CFM performance, calibration, and failure modes remain underexplored.

inputs: in-context examples of causal inference tasks

title: Geometry of braided DNA dictates supercoiling partitioning
task: Determine how DNA fork geometry modulates supercoiling partitioning during replication
key_results: Small end separations promote braiding initiation with low torsional resistance; large separations create torsional barrier preventing fork rotation, shifting supercoiling ahead of replisome
comments: Angular optical trap measurements directly probe torsional mechanics, but in vivo validation of predicted supercoiling partition during active replication is lacking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DNA fork geometry controls torsional resistance and supercoiling partitioning direction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; small separations promote braiding and behind-fork accumulation; large separations create barrier promoting ahead-fork accumulation

title: Ki-67 regulates heterochromatin organization in neurons and forms condensates with heterochromatic components
task: Elucidate Ki-67's role in heterochromatin organization and phase separation
key_results: Ki-67 modulates heterochromatin compartment size and number; engineered Ki-67 enhances HP1α and nucleosome condensate formation via electrostatic interactions robust to histone PTMs
comments: Multi-model approach (in vivo, in vitro, computational) strengthens mechanism but phase separation role remains correlative rather than causative.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ki-67 regulates heterochromatin via phase separation with HP1α and nucleosomes
hypotheses.result: Supported by enhanced condensate formation and electrostatic interaction mapping; disruption observed in disease models

title: Cohesin prevents local mixing of condensed euchromatic domains in living human cells
task: Characterize cohesin's role in organizing condensed euchromatic domains and transcriptional regulation
key_results: Cohesin organizes euchromatin into condensed looped domains; cohesin loss increased nucleosome-level fluidity within domains without altering overall compaction, compromising transcriptional insulation
comments: Single-nucleosome tracking and super-resolution SIM provide nanoscopic resolution, but functional linking of domain integrity to transcriptional output requires direct kinetic measurements.

model_io.model: Living human cells with euchromatin H3.3 labeling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cohesin constrains nucleosome mixing within euchromatic domains to maintain transcriptional insulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cohesin loss increased local mixing and domain fluidity, reducing transcriptional insulation without gross decompaction

title: Mutation E300 recommended by protein language models gives ChrimsonR amplified photocurrent response
task: Identify ChrimsonR mutations using protein language models to enhance photocurrent response
key_results: E300G and E300P mutations increased sustained photocurrents ~4.6-fold (305–255 pA vs 66 pA control), reduced EC₅₀ at 575 nm from 0.19 to 0.07 mW, increased τ_off from 0.06 to 0.40 s
comments: Zero-shot ESM models effectively screened a large mutation space, but the mechanism underlying E300 substitutions' enhancement remains structurally unresolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Protein language models identify mutations that enhance photocurrent independently of task-specific training
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; E300G/E300P produced sustained photocurrent increases and improved light sensitivity with altered kinetics

title: 3D live monitoring of Blebbistatin effect on glioma cells using digital holographic microscopy
task: Quantify morphological changes in glioma cells under Blebbistatin treatment
key_results: Blebbistatin induced time-dependent increases in cell surface roughness and alterations in optical volume; effects attributed to localized membrane contraction and reduced mechanical rigidity
comments: Label-free DHM provides quantitative 3D morphometry but lacks direct mechanistic validation of contractility disruption at molecular resolution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Blebbistatin disrupts actomyosin contractility, causing membrane contraction and loss of rigidity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by increased surface roughness and significant morphological alterations over time

title: N-terminal thrombospondin-1 enhances muscle function and tissue-specific metabolic adaptation in response to exercise and cold exposure
task: Identify and characterize N-TSP1 as an exercise and cold-responsive factor regulating metabolic adaptation
key_results: N-TSP1 administration enhanced muscle strength, increased energy expenditure, attenuated insulin resistance, and improved physical performance in aged mice; positive correlation with muscle mass in humans
comments: Comprehensive in vivo validation across metabolic contexts, but mechanistic insights into TSP1 processing and receptor engagement are limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: N-TSP1 acts as a shared circulating mediator of exercise and cold-induced metabolic adaptation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: N-TSP1 upregulated by both stimuli; administration mimics metabolic phenotypes

title: Systematic benchmarking of ambient RNA decontamination tools to advance precision in single-cell transcriptomic analysis
task: Systematically benchmark computational tools for ambient RNA decontamination in single-cell RNA-seq
key_results: Comparative evaluation of multiple ambient RNA removal tools pending (abstract provides problem motivation only)
comments: Title and abstract indicate methodological benchmarking study but key results not provided in abstract; likely to establish best practices for scRNA-seq preprocessing.

model_io.model: Single-cell RNA sequencing computational pipeline comparison
inputs: scRNA-seq datasets with ambient RNA contamination

title: Dynamic regulation of a domesticated DNA transposon-derived gene, in human germline and early embryonic development
task: Characterize developmentally regulated expression of domesticated DNA transposon THAP9 in human germline
key_results: THAP9 enriched in primordial germ cells, transiently silenced in somatic lineages, and post-meiotically enriched in spermatids; reduced in azoospermic testes
comments: Elegant integrative epigenomic and transcriptomic approach; functional role in gametogenesis remains mechanistically unresolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: THAP9 has sex-specific, developmentally regulated functions in gametogenesis and embryogenesis

title: The mechanistic and evolutionary diversity of programmed DNA elimination

key_results: Comparative analysis reveals PDE linked to gene silencing, germline differentiation, genome defence, and sex determination; occurs widely across phylogenetic groups with mechanistic diversity and previously unappreciated genome plasticity
comments: Broad conceptual synthesis identifying knowledge gaps; specific quantitative mechanisms and evolutionary conservation patterns would require detailed examination of individual systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PDE recurrently emerges across diverse eukaryotic lineages due to adaptive advantages in gene regulation and genome management
hypotheses.result: Supported by comparative phylogenetic evidence; specific adaptive drivers and mechanistic constraints remain incompletely characterized

title: Macrophages transfer functional proteins to their surface during live-cell uptake
task: Demonstrate functional protein transfer from target cells to macrophage surface during live-cell uptake
key_results: Intact target cancer cell surface proteins transferred to macrophage surface at functionally impactful levels; widespread acquisition reengineers macrophage proteome; transcriptionally silent, cell-nonautonomous process
comments: Novel proteomics-based discovery challenging conventional degradation-centric model; quantification of transferred protein burden relative to endogenous proteome and functional impact spectrum warrant further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Macrophages acquire functional target cell proteins during live-cell uptake via non-degradative transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: widespread intact protein transfer to macrophage surface with metabolic consequences

title: MemBrain v2: an end-to-end tool for the analysis of membranes in cryo-electron tomography

key_results: MemBrain v2 provides generalizable membrane segmentation across variable tomographic conditions; data-efficient particle localization via geometric constraints + deep learning; quantitative spatial metrics for intramembrane particle organization
comments: Well-integrated technical pipeline addressing major cryo-ET bottlenecks; real-world generalization performance and user accessibility would benefit from independent benchmarking.

title: Human endometrial cell–conditioned medium enhances sperm chromatin integrity through HSPA2-containing uterosomes in vitro
task: Assess uterosome-mediated HSPA2 transfer for improving sperm chromatin integrity
key_results: Endometrial cell-conditioned medium contains HSPA2-positive uterosomes; EC-CM incubation improved sperm chromatin abnormalities in vitro
comments: Promising exosome-based mechanism for male factor infertility, but direct quantification of HSPA2 transfer and functional validation of chromatin remodeling outcomes incomplete.

model_io.model: In vitro sperm-endometrial cell interaction model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Endometrial uterosomes transfer HSPA2 to sperm, improving chromatin remodeling

title: Optimized cloning and expression of recombinant human type I collagen in mammalian cells using Ubiquitous Chromatin Opening Elements for enhanced protein production

key_results: UCOE-COL1A1 constructs achieved 2.23-fold increase in COL1A1 production in Expi293F versus HEK293T cells; proper C-terminal cleavage confirmed; endotoxin-free purification achieved
comments: Practical bioprocess optimization with solid yield improvement; mechanism of UCOE-mediated enhancement in this specific context not explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: UCOE vectors enhance COL1A1 expression in Expi293F cells relative to HEK293T
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 2.23-fold improvement; proper protein maturation and purification achieved

title: Salinomycin modulates viability, invasion, and inflammatory responses in primary endometriotic stromal cell cultures in association with Wnt/β-catenin signaling
task: Determine Salinomycin effects on endometriotic stromal cells via Wnt/β-catenin pathway modulation
key_results: Salinomycin dose- and time-dependently reduced viability in endometriotic cells (>control); decreased invasion, IL-6/IL-8 secretion; increased β-catenin phosphorylation (Ser45), reduced AXIN2/Cyclin D1/MMP-9, increased Caspase-3
comments: MTT assay cannot distinguish proliferation arrest from cytotoxicity/metabolic changes; findings support further investigation but direct causative link to Wnt pathway modulation requires additional validation.

model_io.model: Primary endometriotic and control endometrial stromal cell cultures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Salinomycin selectively targets endometriotic stromal cells through Wnt/β-catenin pathway inhibition

title: Trivalent arsenicals enhance UVA-associated genomic instability in human keratinocyte models
task: Investigate synergistic genotoxicity of trivalent arsenicals and UVA in keratinocytes
key_results: Co-exposure increased chromosomal instability particularly in p53-deficient cells despite minimal additive comet signal; micronucleus formation disproportionately elevated; altered replication/checkpoint gene expression
comments: Sophisticated multi-endpoint analysis reveals dissociation between initial DNA damage and downstream genomic outcomes, suggesting damage-processing rather than damage-induction mechanism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Arsenicals enhance UVA genotoxicity by altering oxidative DNA damage processing rather than increasing initial lesion burden
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: efficient lesion resolution in primary cells but selective repair impairment in p53-mutant cells; micronucleus elevation without proportional strand-break increase

title: Protective effects of nicotine-treated peritoneal macrophage–conditioned medium on testicular function and spermatogenesis in an experimental rat model of rheumatoid arthritis
task: Evaluate protective effects of nicotine-treated macrophage secretome against RA-induced testicular damage
key_results: N-MCM treatment improved sperm parameters, restored redox balance, and reduced apoptosis-related gene expression to control levels; superior efficacy vs. U-MCM and methylprednisolone
comments: Comprehensive reproductive endpoint assessment; secretome composition and inflammatory mediator profiles not characterized, limiting mechanistic attribution.

model_io.model: Complete Freund's Adjuvant-induced RA rat model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nicotine priming alters macrophage secretome to provide immunomodulatory, antioxidant, and anti-apoptotic protection

title: Gut microbiota composition outperforms chronological age in predicting systemic inflammation and incident disease risk

key_results: Microbiota composition explained more variance than age for 97% of cytokines and 84% of physiological variables; Bacteroides 2 enterotype showed inflammaging phenotype 37 years earlier; associated with 1.21× increased disease risk

title: Spatial structures of tumor and immune cells shape outcomes in ER⁺HER2⁻ and triple-negative breast cancer

comments: Rigorous symmetry analysis resolving Nielsen–Ninomiya theorem constraint; predicted boron structures await experimental synthesis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Minimal heterogeneous chiral fermion pairs (one WP + one DP) can exist under strict symmetry constraints
hypotheses.result: Found in only 24 magnetic/nonmagnetic space groups; boron enantiomorphs confirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: c-axis strain preserves charge topology; a-axis strain splits Weyl point
hypotheses.result: C=+2 WP splits into two C=+1 WPs under a-axis strain while preserving C=−2 DP
